text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: (This is—the finale!)

text_block_list.name: Blast One Piece
text_block_list.text:
Th-That was amazing!
Everyone's sounds became one!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Right?! That feeling of being in sync gave us such a push!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Fufu... it really did. Playing alongside everyone... I could truly feel our hearts harmonizing.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Eye-san, did somethin' change about ya?
Felt like yer sound got a whole lot softer.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I learned the feeling of... surrendering to the music.
Fufu, it's the secret to playing comfortably.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Even during the actual show—I want all of us to enjoy each and every moment of sound, just as our hearts desire.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: And then—... letting our spontaneous impulses take over, we'll raise the voltage through the roof!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Let's make this a live concert that will completely shake the hearts of everyone in the audience!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Standing on the stage, Almond Eye shone brightly, looking as though she were freely enjoying every bit of the performance.

text_block_list.name: Blast One Piece
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Seeing everyone having so much fun makes me so happy!!
Boo's heart is joining in too—!!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh, brilliant playin', Eye-san.
—Count me in too!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Eye-chan really is incredible!
Your singing voice, your performance... your brilliance.
Everyone gets pulled in by it. Completely captivated.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—But that's why. That's why
I can't afford to lose...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: At that moment, a guitar roared out like a beast's bellow.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Such a fierce, biting guitar riff...
—Heh, nice one, Kiseki-chan.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I accept your challenge!
Let's clash with everything we've got!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's what I'm talking about!
Predictable harmony is boring!
Can you keep up with this, Eye-chan?!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh! A sudden key change...!?
—Bring it on! Let's see what you've got!

text_block_list.name: Blast One Piece
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Me too!
I'm gonna blast it out even louder—!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: —Hmph, can't be helped. I'll back ya up too!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
(Whenever someone makes a move, another sound chases them down without giving an inch.
It's like a breathtaking dead heat...!)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
(And yet... it feels absolute bliss.
These unpredictable waves of rhythm are accelerating us faster and faster!)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
(The sounds, the passion, the hearts of the four of us
are surging together—...!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The venue's voltage soared past all limits.
Engulfed in waves of cheering, I couldn't take my eyes off the four shining figures on stage—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
*Pant*, *pant*...
—...Ah...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Live concerts... music—...!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Is the absolute greatest!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...*Pant*, *gasp*..., Eye-chan!
How'd ya like that! My guitar skills!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... *gasp*, ...fufu.
That was intensely thrilling! —Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: To share my thoughts on the magnificent concert, I visited the waiting room with refreshments.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! ...Fufu,
you thoroughly enjoyed it, didn't you?
I can tell just by looking at your face!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
And you even brought refreshments—...
What did you bring for us?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Mmm~... delicious♪

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
It's seepin' right into my overheated body...
Thanks a bunch, Trainer-san.
choice_data_list: It really was an amazing live concert!
It really was an amazing live concert!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
—Just playing well on my own could never have produced that kind of impulse.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Layering four sounds, crashing our hearts together...!
It's because everyone was there that we could stand on such an incredible stage!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Thank you.
Ah, it's so cold and refreshing... I feel revived.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
...I did it.
So intensely that I lost track of sheet music entirely—
my body was screaming out all on its own...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: For now, please... let me bask in this pleasant, lingering exhaustion just a little longer. ...Fufu♪
